config.order: one process, one backend load, conditions in the listed order
config.historical_po_reuse: NOT reused: the historical PO set was decoded with 16 sentences per batch (64 rows) and selected at length 512, so its first 128 tokens are not the output of a 4 x 128 run under the same execution protocol; PO is regenerated at 4 x 128
config.pool_capture: opt-in audit hook; at every step every parent's top-(w+1) tokens by (logP desc, token id asc) with parent cum logP, logP and full [24, 60] routing counts; this reduced pool provably contains the global top-(w+1) for ANY per-parent sigma, so it is exact for counterfactual ranking

note: all balance outcomes use the canonical EQ4_RATE definition; internal_sigma_mean is each variant's own score term and is not comparable across variants
